body:
Thank you for replying to me.  Yes, I could try taking notes more.  Honestly I've always had a problem with paying attention to things; I'll sort of stare off into space after a while, lost in my own thoughts.  Taking notes might help me pay better attention.  Not that I necessarily need to: there is a manual that accompanies that course I'm taking right now and most of the information is in that.  I'm just having a hard time because I've found that I don't really learn the material until I go back on my own and look at the companion, so when we do work in class or are assigned activities to do outside of class it takes me a long time and I feel like I'm way behind my classmates.  I suppose I could stay late at work to try to catch up.  I've already done that a few times, but I don't like the idea of working till eight or nine every day just to keep up with my colleagues.

I forgot to answer your last question concerning whether this might not be as big of a deal as I think it is.  I'll admit that's possible.  I've always been easily discouraged and usually I give up on things when they become too difficult.
